body:
I think the next step is to author a dark mode version of our themes based on [`prefers-color-scheme`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/@media/prefers-color-scheme) (which [should work with GTK](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/epiphany/-/issues/720)).

We can sort out the details later, but we could provide each scheme separately if the impact on bundle size is too big.
